cycles.method: The dearest key press: CUE + FUNC + STOP inserting 56 copied rows at row 0 of a 200-row arrangement (256 after it: the largest undo copy, row move and target pass). Executed instructions between the base's key site 0x40061dc8 and its return 0x40061dce, read with ot_emu's watch/hits (octabam f7d72906, the adapted emulator, --dsp --dsp-rt, MKI panel), on the beta base 0.7.5 built from the developer's 1.40C, package a0e796c2 (source 80e94f2be), 17 November 2026: 131,124 instructions, the module's message box and editor redraw included; its undo 96,899. Instructions, not cycles: at a few cycles each still about two hundred times under the budget. Measured on 0.1.0-experimental; 0.2.0 adds the move (CUE + LEFT/RIGHT), a single pass over at most 256 rows, cheaper than this insert.

stress.method: ot_emu, the same build and base: the arrangement playing, the dearest press (an insert of 56 rows and its undo, alternating) 20 times, STOP, PLAY, a Part change (FUNC + MIDI, Part 3), the editor reopened, 20 more; the transport ran throughout (0x800065b8 = 1) and stopped only on STOP, the screen kept updating, and the arrangement ended at its 200 rows.
